paper_source.title: TRIAGE-Fuse: Bioinformatics-Guided Tri-Level Evidence Fusion for Traceable Protein Interaction Prediction

immutable_innovation.problem_formulation: protein interaction prediction as cross-resolution evidence fusion rather than a single opaque score
immutable_innovation.L1: residue hotspot logits/probabilities, Top-K residue proposals and an L1 evidence vector/logit
immutable_innovation.L2: L1-guided sparse residue-pair scoring, optional geometry bias, 2D refinement, Top-M support, an L2 evidence vector/logit and weak MIL linkage
immutable_innovation.L3: attention-pooled chain summaries, difference/agreement pair context, optional structure summary and an L3 evidence vector/logit
immutable_innovation.T_MEB: sample-adaptive simplex gates over L1/L2/L3 evidence vectors with logit-level fusion before sigmoid
native_traceability: L1/L2/L3 evidence vectors and branch logits

equation_contract.L2_sparse_support: Top-M selected from the masked/refined interface-logit map and softmax-weighted into z_L2
equation_contract.L2_to_L1: max sigmoid(interface logit) over the opposite chain
equation_contract.gate: g = softmax(W_g [z_L1 || z_L2 || z_L3] + b_g), g>=0, sum(g)=1
equation_contract.fusion: logit_PPI = g_L1*logit_L1 + g_L2*logit_L2 + g_L3*logit_L3; sigmoid only after fusion
equation_contract.reliability: diagnostic evidence-consistency readout; not calibrated uncertainty or causal evidence

OSA_allowed_adjustments: canonical UniProt and feature-manifest input adapters
explicit missing-modality masks and availability tiers
A-B/B-A bidirectional inference for unordered protein pairs
batched inference, caching and resumable output
post-model OSA context construction and ranking
OSA_forbidden_adjustments: removing or bypassing L1, L2, L3 or T-MEB in the full model
replacing L2 with a generic dense contact score or mean pooling in the primary model
probability averaging before T-MEB logit fusion
injecting OSA expression evidence into L1/L2/L3 representations or gates
calling r_OSA or the combined priority score a physical interaction probability
using CPAP/adipose/single-cell/proteome validation to select a checkpoint, feature policy, pair, threshold or weight
interpreting gate weights as causal biological effects
interpreting the reliability readout as calibrated uncertainty

checkpoint_compatibility_note.observed_base_implementation: the archived model uses chain-specific A/B projection, encoder and residue-head modules
checkpoint_compatibility_note.paper_alignment_for_frozen_OSA_inference: preserve the trained checkpoint and evaluate both A-B and B-A; average scalar logits and align native residue/interface maps back to the original indexing
checkpoint_compatibility_note.future_shared_weight_refactor: requires a newly trained checkpoint and must be evaluated as a separate architecture version; it cannot be substituted into the frozen analysis
